# Index of Concepts {.unnumbered}

Search finds every occurrence of a word. This index instead points to the place where a concept receives its fullest explanation and, selectively, to places where the book extends, tests, or applies it. **Main treatment** identifies the primary explanation; **related** links identify substantive extensions rather than incidental mentions. *See also* connects ideas that are easy to confuse or especially useful together. Major demonstrations and cases remain indexed separately in [Appendix B](appendices/appendix-b-index-of-major-course-examples.qmd).
